notes: Setup chooses who runs the ride clock on each rough-stock event: Kinex (phones and board, with the horn) or the FarmTek console. On a kit phone the volume keys start and stop the ride clock. The PIN lockout counts per phone and per PIN, so one judge's wrong tries never lock the rest out. Everybody tied at the short-round cut comes back, and the board says so. Marks from the phones are stamped with the laptop's time.
